mentions.name: Tubula
mentions.description: This app lets families create shared email addresses, such as a school address on their family's tubula.io subdomain, that forward to multiple recipients like both parents, with no DNS configuration required.
mentions.problem: Families had to manually forward school emails between parents; the builder was tired of forwarding school emails to their spouse.
mentions.audience: Families and parents who need shared handling of school and household emails.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built Tubula because I was tired of forwarding school emails to my spouse. Now families can create shared email addresses like school AT jones.tubula.io that forward to both parents - no DNS configuration needed.
